correctness.rationale: For rank-one A, det([[A,u],[v^T,z]])=-gamma for every z; the gamma=0/unequal-zero exactness classes are exhaustive and exact ReLU rank cannot be one with the eight prescribed positives. The exact constructive witness t=-gamma/(B||A||^2+eta) has determinant zero via adj(A+t adj(A)^T)=adj(A)+t A^T and all eight observed entries positive for large B, with loss t^2||A||^2. Every small-loss rank-two candidate has observed perturbation O(1/B); its vanishing determinant forces B|det(A+H)|>=|gamma|-O(1/B), while |det(A+H)|<=||A||delta+delta^2/2. This supplies the matching global coefficient, not just an experimental bound. Compactness shows E(B)>0 for all finite B. 1600 exact symbolic determinant and norm checks were executed on random rational examples.
